audit_metadata.audit_title: AIDigiTools Forensic Full-Website, SEO, AI Visibility & Business Audit
audit_metadata.audit_mode: READ-ONLY FORENSIC INVESTIGATION (Zero Production Modifications Applied)

issues.evidence: Lines 92-100 of conversion_analytics.py define base_impressions=48500, base_clicks=2650, base_confirmed=98 and scale linearly by period. Generates synthetic 48.5k imp / 2,650 clicks / 98 orders in analytics_report_28d.json.
issues.current_behavior: Automated reports present fabricated 48.5k impressions and 98 orders as verified fact.
issues.expected_behavior: Reports must only reflect authentic first-party data from connected GSC/GA4/CRM APIs, or explicitly label simulations as MOCK / TEST FIXTURES.
issues.root_cause: Hardcoded synthetic multipliers embedded in conversion_analytics.py without live API pull or simulation disclaimer.
issues.impact: Misleading strategic decisions, inaccurate business metrics, and high compliance risk if cited publicly.
issues.recommendation: Tag all analytics_report_*.json as synthetic/unverified test fixtures. Refactor conversion_analytics.py to require verified API authentication or mark mock mode explicitly.

issues.evidence: 1073 broken glyphs (540 U+FFFD replacement characters, 533 literal ?? strings) actively visible on production (e.g. tools/adobe-creative-cloud.html). Traceable to git commit eee2c84 committed 2026-11-24 12:09:27+05:00.
issues.current_behavior: Buttons, tags, headings, and CTAs render as '?? Orders Accepted', 'Smart Tools  Bigger Possibilities', and '?? Quick Order'.
issues.expected_behavior: Clean UTF-8 typography and emojis: '🟢 Orders Accepted', 'Smart Tools • Bigger Possibilities', '⚡ Quick Order'.
issues.root_cause: Commit eee2c84 read and wrote HTML files in Windows ANSI encoding instead of UTF-8, mangling 4-byte Unicode emojis and em dashes.
issues.impact: Severe destruction of buyer trust, unprofessional storefront appearance, broken readability.
issues.recommendation: Perform automated UTF-8 restoration across all 49 tools/*.html files using pre-corruption baseline git commit eee2c84~1, enforcing strict UTF-8 without BOM.

issues.scope: Google Search Console Page Indexing Report
issues.evidence: GSC records 15 indexed vs 58 not indexed. Breakdown: 44 Crawled - currently not indexed, 13 Discovered - currently not indexed, 1 Alternative page with proper canonical tag.
issues.current_behavior: 79% of site routes are rejected from Google index following crawl.
issues.expected_behavior: Unique commercial tool pages and comparison pillars should qualify for indexing.
issues.root_cause: Thin templated content across tool pages, lack of external backlinks, and identical boilerplate text causing Google algorithms to classify pages as low-quality duplicates.
issues.impact: Severe organic search invisibility. Site cannot rank or generate organic traffic if pages are not indexed.
issues.recommendation: Enrich top-priority tool pages with original Pakistani benchmark tests, unique use-case tables, and internal link equity from indexed pillars. Remove repetitive payment boilerplates.

issues.scope: Site-wide footers, headers, meta descriptions, and GSC query report
issues.evidence: Top GSC queries are 'sadapay' (30 imp), 'nayapay' (27 imp), 'jazzcash' (10 imp), 'easypaisa' (5 imp) with 0 clicks. GSC report GSC_SEO_PERFORMANCE_LATEST.md proves payment cannibalization across dozens of unrelated pages.
issues.current_behavior: Google associates AIDigiTools with digital wallet searches rather than AI software, generating worthless zero-click impressions.
issues.expected_behavior: Impressions should concentrate on AI tool names (Cursor Pro, ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro, Midjourney).
issues.root_cause: Repeated boilerplate strings mentioning SadaPay, NayaPay, JazzCash, EasyPaisa across every tool page and footer.
issues.impact: Dilutes topical authority, wastes crawl budget, and misaligns search intent.
issues.recommendation: Consolidate domestic payment keywords into the dedicated /policies.html#payments pillar. Remove repetitive keyword stuffing from individual tool headers and titles.

issues.evidence: GA4 records 0 key events and 0 custom events in 30 days. analytics-events.js binds to a[href*='wa.me'] on DOMContentLoaded, missing all dynamically rendered checkout links in cart.js. blog.html is completely missing the GA4 tag.
issues.current_behavior: Outbound WhatsApp clicks and Quick Order modal interactions are not tracked as conversion events in GA4.
issues.expected_behavior: Every Quick Order open, plan selection, and WhatsApp checkout click should emit structured events to GA4.
issues.root_cause: Selector binding mismatch between static DOMContentLoaded listeners and dynamic runtime DOM rendering in cart.js.
issues.impact: Complete loss of conversion attribution. Impossible to know which channels, landing pages, or tools drive orders.
issues.recommendation: Implement event delegation (document.addEventListener('click', ...)) matching dynamic cart elements and install GA4 tag on blog.html.

issues.evidence: GMC displays 'No products added yet' and scheduled auto-crawl addition on 11 Dec 2026. merchant_feed.xml exists in repo but was never registered as a Primary Data Source. Order flow directs to WhatsApp concierge rather than automated cart checkout.
issues.current_behavior: Merchant Center has 0 active products. Automated crawl may disapprove concierge/inquiry access under Google Shopping policies.
issues.expected_behavior: Compliant Merchant Center integration aligned with Google digital goods and landing page requirements.
issues.root_cause: Data source never configured; mismatch between Google Shopping direct-checkout requirements and WhatsApp concierge sales model.
issues.impact: Risk of Merchant Center account suspension or disapproved product listings if Google auto-adds products on Dec 11.
issues.recommendation: Pause auto-addition in GMC settings. Conduct formal policy audit before submitting merchant_feed.xml, ensuring landing pages meet Google Shopping requirements for digital subscriptions.

issues.evidence: admin/meta-integration.html has index, follow meta tag and is public on GitHub Pages. robots.txt allows AI crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, GPTBot, etc.) full '/' access without admin disallows.
issues.current_behavior: Internal administration dashboard is publicly accessible and eligible for search engine indexing.
issues.expected_behavior: Admin dashboards should have 'noindex, nofollow' and be disallowed across all user-agents in robots.txt.
issues.root_cause: Static file placed in public repository without noindex directive or comprehensive AI bot disallow rules.
issues.impact: Exposure of internal catalog sync dashboards, operational intelligence leakage.
issues.recommendation: Add '<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">' to admin/meta-integration.html and update robots.txt to disallow /admin/ and /data/previews/ for all crawlers including AI bots.

issues.evidence: Lines 18 and 38 contain trailing '>>' syntax errors leaking visible text above navbar. Meta description contains blanked price '/  USD'.
issues.current_behavior: Stray '>> >> >>' rendered above top header in browser.
issues.expected_behavior: Clean HTML without stray angle brackets; complete price string ('$8.00 USD' and '$9.00 USD').
issues.root_cause: Manual editing typo and unescaped copy paste.
issues.impact: Visible cosmetic glitch and incomplete meta snippet in search results.
issues.recommendation: Fix description tags and delete stray '>>' characters.

issues.evidence: Lighthouse flags color contrast failures on status badges (#a7f3d0 / #065f46) and accessible name mismatch on Quick Order buttons.
issues.current_behavior: Screen readers receive confusing button names; low vision users experience reduced readability.
issues.expected_behavior: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant color contrast (>= 4.5:1) and matching accessible aria-labels.
issues.root_cause: Light green and cyan badges styled with insufficient contrast ratio against light backgrounds.
issues.impact: Decreased accessibility score and degraded user experience for visually impaired users.
issues.recommendation: Adjust CSS variable contrast and align button aria-label with visible button text.

issues.evidence: 6 workflows possess contents: write with scheduled cron triggers pushing directly to main. Overlapping 04:00 UTC schedules for auto-blog-publisher.yml and content_intelligence_scheduler.yml.
issues.current_behavior: Automated scripts commit directly to main without pull request review or human verification.
issues.expected_behavior: Automated agents should submit Pull Requests for human review, preventing automated data corruption.
issues.root_cause: Direct commit permissions configured in workflow action checkout steps.
issues.impact: High risk of automated regressions, encoding damage, or race conditions corrupting production.
issues.recommendation: Change workflow permissions to create branches and PRs rather than pushing directly to main.
